purpose: Records required before estimating actual data-center effects; current data permit audit and description only

nitrate_samples.source: Iowa DNR and supplying utilities; obtain native exports with data dictionary

analytes.1038: nitrate plus nitrite, separate sensitivity only

nitrate_samples.handling: Preserve native values; do not create records from CCR ranges or violations. New native schemas need an explicit reviewed field map. Never append the hybrid nitrate file as independent nitrate observations.

facilities.handling: A tracker is a lead. Validate each event and phase from permits, utility records or primary announcements. Do not infer operation from announced capacity.

source_links.handling: Specify source-contamination versus municipal-demand pathways. A local watershed is not the supply network.

confounders.handling: Use observed measurements. For a total effect, distinguish confounders from treatment-induced changes; do not control for mediators automatically.

exposure_design_csv.pwsid: Verified source or supply unit matching outcome records
exposure_design_csv.status: treated or never_by_cutoff; unresolved rows rejected
exposure_design_csv.event_date: YYYY-MM-DD verified physical event; blank only for verified unexposed controls
exposure_design_csv.verified: true after source and timing review
exposure_design_csv.exposure_definition: Documented source transport or supplier connection; proximity exploratory only
exposure_design_csv.evidence_url: Primary evidence for event and connection
exposure_design_csv.ascertained_through: Date through which treated/control status has been comprehensively checked

current_gate: No causal effect, equivalence, or mechanism attribution is reported from the verified inputs.
